notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/da7a1578ceeb6e51f7e2ef9523b7380bdd7b141d.jpg[/img]
Attention, Sprawl denizens! 

We pushed a hotfix today for the PC/Mac versions of the game. The fix addresses an issue that caused it to freeze in levels 1-3 if you access the level select screen. 

Thanks to everyone for playing and for supporting us with your great feedback! ❤️

notes.title: Patch Update: Bug and Continuity Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/87342a3e6972cb2059d06e296393373cb1ee93cd.png[/img]

Greetings to all members of the Sprawl’s City Council, Mages Guild, Guard Corp, and Goblin Liberation Army! 

Thanks to our community’s amazing feedback, we have released an update that addresses a number of issues. We are so grateful to everyone who took time to share their experience and who helped us improve our game. This won’t be the last update, so please keep sharing with us as you play! 

[b]Bugs squashed: [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed navigation issue in Garby’s Alley that resulted in Lil getting stuck in the bottom right corner of the location
[*] Fixed bug that caused Dwarf Tinkerer to ignore player after interacting with him in level 3 if you restarted using the level select function, making it impossible to fix the jukebox.
[*] Fixed a bug where using a specific series of inputs between good and low-budget crystals you could soft-lock the game in the toolkit
[*] Fixed typo in Bosco Hoolihan’s turn in level 8 that revealed to the world what our placeholder character sprite looks like (note: it looks like the MSN messenger icon!)
[*] Fixed Spanish, German and Chinese localization for bullwhip upgrade description in Garby's Shoppe.
[*] Fixed issue in Level 11 Meribella turn. [spoiler]You can no longer destroy her shell, and then discover it again.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]Continuity Nips & Tucks: [/b]

[list]
[*] Issue with Grumpkin T. Dankworth in level 8 & 10 [spoiler]If you reunite Grumpkin with Whelp and his end of day result indicates they run off together and he dies, you will not see him at the docks in level 10![/spoiler]
[*] Fixed continuity error involving Julian and Gary Goblin in levels 4 and 6. [spoiler]If you jail them, you won’t see them at jail anymore during level 6 but instead at the Goblin Liberation Army Headquarters.[/spoiler] 
[*] Fixed continuity error involving Gary Goblin in level 12. [spoiler]Fixed bug where if you saved Gary from turning to the dark side, he obviously won’t be in the final confrontation with Tyronius (and die).[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed continuity error with the Troll suspect in level 9. [spoiler]If you jail the troll, he obviously can’t be in the tavern with his human date![/spoiler]
[/list]

- The Hilltop Games Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924360/Lil_Guardsman/

Join the community:

[url=https://discord.gg/YXtyDmHNUn]DISCORD[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/lilguardsman]TWITTER[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/PlayHilltop]HILLTOP TWITTER[/url]

notes.title: Lil’ Guardsman - Demo Tips & Tricks! ✏️
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924360/Lil_Guardsman/

Good day, future Guardsman!

There are some key points that you need to be familiar with: the guardsman toolkit, the royal writ, the advisors, & the Wicket3000. Once you familiarize yourself with these you will be armed & ready for anything (well almost anything…).

Make sure to check out our [url=https://versusevil.com/blog/lil-guardsman-tool-guide/]Lil' Guardsman Tool Guide blog[/url] to help prepare for what's ahead. Good luck & we hope you enjoy the Lil' Guardsman Demo. Don't forget to wishlist it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924360/Lil_Guardsman/]Steam[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/818a588a8a5e441a8b8b6ce3aae37f680479ee69.png[/img]

Notice: Before you hop into the demo, we have a quick note about localization. Although the full version of the game will support Chinese (Simplified), German, and Spanish (Latin America) at launch, this demo is available in English only for now. We hope to have a localized version available very soon!

[b]Demo Notes:[/b]
– Non-English language versions not yet implemented
– Partial gamepad support – to be fully implemented for public demo release, but currently working & playable

[list]
[h3]TOOLS AT YOUR DISPOSAL[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/87419f0910982b2a1dcd7f6e1cf3f0774acae63b.png[/img]


[*] [b]Truth Spray:[/b]
Spritz away at someone suspicious who you think could be lying, & the truth will be revealed.

[*] [b]Metal Detector:[/b]
Use this to uncover hidden metal objects, from weapons to gold & more.

[*] [b]Bullwhip:[/b]
We don’t know when to recommend using this, but you’ll know when the time is right…

[*] [b]X-Ray:[/b]
When you need to search for concealed contraband, use the handy X-Ray!

[*] [b]Decoder Ring:[/b]
When there's something that needs to be translated or may contain a hidden message, your best bet is the Decoder Ring.


[h3]THE ROYAL WRIT, THE COUNCIL MEMBERS & THE WICKET3000[/h3]


[*] [b]The Royal Writ:[/b]
This document contains daily instructions from the royal advisors that you will receive at the beginning of every shift. Its may contain intelligence about world events, known criminals to be on the lookout for, & more to advance the advisors' agendas... we mean keep the Sprawl safe for the public good!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/2ff4c132fa48328f2947c4aefc7692df5052d5f6.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Lieutenant Meg Stryker:[/b]
The de facto martial leader of the Sprawl. She advises the Princess on military matters, and also oversees the day to day policing of the city. Her years of training and service have sharpened her into an effective, direct leader; though you wouldn’t think of her as being a traditional 'compromiser'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/29e7d2f0371a6c6e7fd5b20cdaba861aba6a441c.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Councilwoman Isadora Ashe:[/b]
Councilwoman Isadora Ashe has fabricated a backstory of being highborn from a distant kingdom. But the truth is she grew up on the mean streets of the Sprawl. Her finely-tuned persona intersects with her tenacity, street smarts, and when needed... viciousness. She is the most well-connected political operator within the Sprawl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/873ae98bbdda72df53d7b412dcc18bb1f21182df.png[/img]

[*] [b]Jester Malcolm (no last name known):[/b]
Everything about Malcolm is a mystery. He juggles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/38ea4667f305ac31774a3ef134de8fd5015baceb.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]The Wicket3000[/b]
This is the contraption used to make your final judgment on whether or not you will be letting someone into the Sprawl. You must be diligent in your questioning and certain about your choice because you cannot undo it (unless you rewind time... but we’ll get into that at a later date). Be sure to press & hold the lever down to generate their photo and stamp of judgment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/05c6cc13a18b2ee031de31ccb8e7da5d1eecee4b.jpg[/img]


[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[*] Q: Do I need to use all three action points before I use the Wicket3000?
A: Nope! You can decide someone’s fate at any point in your interrogation process. In fact, a speedy decision is sometimes the way to unlock a 4-star result. 

[*] Q: Get stuck on what more to do while interrogating a character?
A: Don’t forget to call your advisors, check the Royal Writ & use your tools. Don’t be shy spending action points just talking - sometimes THAT'S the way to unlock a 4-star result.

[*] Q: What is the replay value of the demo?
A: The same as the entire game – we recommend playing through at least a couple times since your choices will decide your story & dialogue path. Between interrogating, your tools, and calling the advisors, there's lots to uncover!

Note: You can skip the intro by holding down the left mouse button.

More General Lil’ G FAQs in our [url=https://discord.gg/lilguardsman]Official Discord Server[/url]!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/87986ff8c07332d9591e4f2ef1b58cf1bf6bb169.png[/img]

notes.title: Lil' Guardsman Demo Patch Notes 📝
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43911356/e85bfac59265e9fc80fcfbfafbd7d11d981ae73c.png[/img]

[h3]Hello Guardsman! [/h3]
We have been absolutely blown away with the reception & feedback for the Lil' Guardsman Demo. Getting this slice of the game out into the public's hands has been such a wonderful experience. The team has worked so hard on this experience of the game. We're so glad that you're enjoying it & we're happy to share the list of updates & fixes coming to the demo below.

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Streamer Layout in settings moves the character dialogue headshots to the lower-right corner of the screen (instead of alternating sides), leaving the lower-left corner open for the streamer on screen
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements to the demo gamepad compatibility (inc. controller issue that would result in a soft lock after tutorial)
[*] Fixed bug with the streamer settings toggling Lil’s VO and NPC’s VO
[*] Misc. bugs squished!
[/list]

[b]Known Issues: [/b]
[list]
[*] Sound settings under construction!
[/list]

Join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/lilguardsman]Official Discord Server[/url] for chit-chat, feedback + bug posting, dev BTS content & more. If you enjoyed your demo experience we'd really appreciate you wishlisting Lil' Guardsman here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924360/Lil_Guardsman/]Steam[/url].

Thank you all & stay safe!

Play as Lil - a 12 year-old girl who lives in The Sprawl - covering for her dad at the guard shed. You'll encounter over 100 zany & unique characters. Deduce their intentions with dialogue and tools, like your trusty X-Ray, Truth Spray and more. The safety of The Sprawl is in your hands!

Make sure to check out our [url=https://versusevil.com/blog/lil-guardsman-tool-guide/]Lil' Guardsman Tool Guide blog[/url] to help prepare you for what's ahead.
